_README: Pinned band axis and period for regression measurement.
period_px is in ORIGINAL image pixels; bandmetrics.py scales it internally.
WHY PINS: re-detecting the period on every run means the metric can move
because DETECTION moved, not because the tool changed. A regression harness
must be deterministic. Auto-detection got 10 of 22 images wrong in the first
baseline run, including jDOn4whY... (wrong axis entirely).
'guard'   = must NOT regress (period peak is wide; insensitive by design)
'unresolved' = no single period resolvable; EXCLUDED from pass/fail
Verified by: harmonic-family spectrum, autocorrelation, per-strip agreement,
and demodulated SNR against control frequencies at 0.80x/1.20x.
